retailPriceSync.syncStoreRetailPricesHint: When checked, store retail prices are changed to the new price right away; when unchecked, store prices stay as they are. Whether stores are notified or asked to swap labels is decided by "Create price tasks" below.
retailPriceSync.generateTasksHint: When checked, price update tasks are created for stores (a "swap labels" task if "Sync store retail prices" is also checked, otherwise a "change price" task). When unchecked, stores are not notified and no task is created; synced store prices are still pushed to HQ immediately, and shelf labels are not changed.
